A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a system for computing location based aggregate statistics that is both private and accountable, and is practical enough to be deployed in a large scale setting.
we have designed and implemented a practical privacy preserving system for aggregate location based statistics that provides provable guarantees on privacy, and accountability.

location based aggregate statistics can be computed in a privacy and accountable manner.
it is possible to achieve privacy preserving aggregate location statistics over large numbers of clients with modest latency and computational overhead.
